units.summary: New test checking that CompactSelectedSeries decrements numStaleSeries only when it evicts a stale series. It does not change production code, and its assertions match how truncateSeries/gcSeries counts deleted stale series.
units.headline: New test: stale counter tracks evicted stale series only
units.reason: New test only; production behavior unaffected.

units.summary: The exported StaleHead type is renamed to SelectedSeriesHead, and its field now uses the generic seriesRefs type. Removing an exported identifier from the tsdb package breaks any downstream Go importer that still references StaleHead.
units.headline: Exported StaleHead type renamed to SelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Removes an exported type from the public tsdb Go API.
focus: Whether a deprecated alias for StaleHead should be kept

units.summary: The exported constructor NewStaleHead is renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead and takes seriesRefs. The body is unchanged, but the old exported name is gone.
units.headline: NewStaleHead constructor renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Removes an exported constructor from the public API.

units.summary: Index now calls the renamed selectedSeriesIndex helper. The renamed helper (in head_read.go) has the same body, so behavior does not change.
units.headline: Index delegates to renamed selectedSeriesIndex
units.reason: Mechanical rename; the delegate has the same body.

units.summary: NumSeries now returns the number of selected refs instead of the head's global stale-series count. For stale compaction the old value could be wrong, because OOO series are filtered out. The value only feeds the view's Meta Stats, which compactor.Write does not rely on.
units.headline: NumSeries reports selected ref count, not head stale count
units.reason: Changes only the view's meta stat; the new value is more accurate and isn't used for compaction decisions.

units.summary: The placeholder ULID for the in-memory view changes. Nothing compares against it, and the old value also contained non-Crockford characters and parsed without error, so this one will too.
units.headline: View placeholder ULID renamed to selectedSeriesHeadULID
units.reason: Changes only the placeholder ULID of an in-memory view; nothing references the value.

units.summary: Meta now uses the renamed ULID variable and is otherwise unchanged. It is only used as compaction input.
units.headline: Meta uses the renamed placeholder ULID
units.reason: Mechanical rename apart from the placeholder ULID value.

units.summary: The String() text changes from 'stale head' to 'selected-series head', which only affects logs and error messages.
units.headline: String text now reads 'selected-series head'
units.reason: Only the human-readable log/error text changes.
